command:
$ErrorActionPreference="Stop"
$dir=Join-Path $env:FLYEXPLORER_CANONICAL_CHECKOUT "logs\search-v3-indexed"
$before=Join-Path $dir "indexed-search-before.bmp"
$after=Join-Path $dir "indexed-search-after.bmp"
if(!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $before) -or !(Test-Path -LiteralPath $after)){throw "visual evidence missing"}
$script=Join-Path $dir "inspect-indexed-visual-20261008.py"
$code=@'
from PIL import Image, ImageChops, ImageDraw
import sys,io,base64
a=Image.open(sys.argv[1]).convert('RGB')
b=Image.open(sys.argv[2]).convert('RGB')
print('INDEXED_VISUAL_BEFORE_DIM',a.size)
print('INDEXED_VISUAL_AFTER_DIM',b.size)
print('INDEXED_VISUAL_SAME_GEOMETRY',a.size==b.size)
if a.size==b.size:
 d=ImageChops.difference(a,b)
 bbox=d.getbbox()
 changed=sum(1 for p in d.getdata() if p!=(0,0,0))
 print('INDEXED_VISUAL_DIFF_BBOX',bbox)
 print('INDEXED_VISUAL_DIFF_PIXELS',changed)
 print('INDEXED_VISUAL_DIFF_PERCENT',round(100*changed/(a.width*a.height),4))
else: print('INDEXED_VISUAL_GEOMETRY_MISMATCH',True)
w=min(a.width,b.width,1000)
h=min(a.height,b.height,720)
canvas=Image.new('RGB',(w,h*2+35),(246,246,246))
canvas.paste(a.crop((0,0,w,h)),(0,15))
canvas.paste(b.crop((0,0,w,h)),(0,h+35))
draw=ImageDraw.Draw(canvas)
draw.text((8,1),'BEFORE',fill=(0,0,0))
draw.text((8,h+20),'AFTER',fill=(0,0,0))
out=io.BytesIO()
canvas.save(out,format='JPEG',quality=73,optimize=True)
print('INDEXED_VISUAL_PREVIEW_BYTES',len(out.getvalue()))
print('INDEXED_VISUAL_PREVIEW_B64',base64.b64encode(out.getvalue()).decode('ascii'))
'@
[System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($script,$code,(New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
try{ & python $script $before $after; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw "visual analysis failed"} }
finally{Remove-Item -LiteralPath $script -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue}
Write-Host "INDEXED_VISUAL_METRICS=PASS"
